sql: SELECT w.obs_date, MAX(CASE WHEN d.d_dow = 6 AND d.d_date = DATE '2024-12-21' THEN w.snow_mm END) AS target_snow_mm, AVG(CASE WHEN d.d_dow = 6 AND d.d_date <> DATE '2024-12-21' THEN w.snow_mm END) AS baseline_avg_snow_mm FROM whybot.nyc_weather_daily w JOIN whybot.yellow_daily y ON y.trip_date = w.obs_date JOIN TPCDS_DB.date_dim d ON d.d_date = y.trip_date WHERE y.trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31' AND d.d_dow = 6 GROUP BY w.obs_date ORDER BY w.obs_date LIMIT 500
